summary: We developed a program targeted to help farmers address soil health, water conservation, and pest resilience through crop rotation.
details: For our project, we built a crop rotation simulator. Our project consists of a homepage, planner, and data/methodology tabs. In the beginning, a user drops a pin on a location of their choice. The farmer then adjusts the settings of the farm, which includes the number of years of simulation and equipment. Then the farmer creates two rotations to compare against each other. The program then visualizes and simulates crop growth as time passes. Finally, the website displays the results, and compares/contrasts the two rotations.
